meta.note: No UI code in the repository yet: brand colours were sampled from the project's own mood test (reference/13), type and component inventory come from the brief (CLAUDE.md, 'Stile visivo' and 'Funzionalità').

tokens.name: fir
tokens.usage: Brand: verde abete scuro, sampled from the mood test. The night-sky ground of the Abete theme and the ink of the Carta theme.

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Brand: rosso ciliegia. Knit bands, primary buttons, stamps, hearts. Never small text: 3.5:1 on paper, 2.3:1 on fir.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand: crema/carta. The ground of the Carta theme, the ink of the Abete theme, the cream stitches of a knit band.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand: oro tenue. Stars, hearts and ornaments on fir (4.3:1, ornaments and 24px+ display only). Never on paper (1.9:1).

tokens.name: fir-deep
tokens.usage: Derived: the deeper fir under the reveal card and the envelope on the Abete theme.

tokens.name: fir-raised
tokens.usage: Derived: raised panels (cards, sheets, inputs) on the fir ground.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Derived: raised panels and kraft-paper tags on the paper ground.

tokens.name: paper-bright
tokens.usage: Derived: polaroid frames and the reveal ticket: the whitest paper in the system.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Derived from gold: the post-it yellow on the moodboard. Text on it is fir (7.1:1).

tokens.name: fir-muted
tokens.usage: Derived: secondary text on paper objects (tags, post-its, polaroids, the ticket) in both themes; 4.7:1 or better on paper-deep, butter and paper-bright.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Derived: gold darkened for ornaments on paper (3:1 or better on paper and paper-bright). Not for text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (the ground).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, wishlist rows: anything set one sheet above the ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Moodboard canvas and wells: the table the paper lies on.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (8.0:1 / 6.5:1 and up in both themes); also control borders.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (dates, captions, helper text) on surface and surface-raised (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fills only: primary button, knit band, stamp, active state. Label on it with on-accent at 19px bold or larger.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and stitches on accent. 3.5:1, so labels on accent are 19px bold or larger only (large-text rule).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Red text: links, errors, the 'già preso' note, small emphasis, on surface and surface-raised (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: Stars, hearts and rules drawn as decoration or icons (3:1 or better on surface in both themes). Gold proper only on fir.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and dashed perforations. Decorative only: controls take ink as their border.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.5:1 on paper, 4.3:1 on fir, 3.5:1 on fir-raised.

tokens.name: postit
tokens.usage: Post-it notes on the moodboard, both themes. Text on it is fir.

tokens.name: photo-frame
tokens.usage: Polaroid frame and the reveal ticket, both themes. Text on it is fir.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The app name on the landing and group header, one per screen.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the name on the reveal ticket.

styles.name: display-heading
styles.sample: La tua busta ti aspetta, Giulia
styles.usage: Section headings, gift-tag names, countdown numbers.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The line under a title: budget, date, theme.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, and every input (never below 16px: iOS zooms).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. 19px bold is what lets on-accent sit on cherry.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, member names in lists.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Giulia ha aggiornato la moodboard · 2 min fa

styles.name: pin
styles.usage: Digits in the PIN boxes and countdown tiles (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Knit stitch size; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between PIN boxes.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of chips, tags and post-its.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter (plus safe-area insets); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a screen above its title; space around a knit band.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on the landing and the reveal.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Paper: tickets, stamps, polaroids, knit bands. Paper is cut square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Post-its, gift tags, inputs and PIN boxes: a slightly worn corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the wishlist panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, member chips, emoji avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Any paper object lying on the ground: post-its, polaroids, tags, tickets.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: An item being dragged on the moodboard, and the open reveal ticket.

tilt.note: Scrapbook rotation. Paper never sits perfectly straight; controls always do.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: Post-its and polaroids, alternating with tilt-right.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: Post-its, gift tags, stamps.

tokens.name: tilt-slight
tokens.usage: The reveal ticket and large cards: a hint, not a lean.
